name: sheaim_horseman
description: a Sheaim Horseman (Fall from Heaven), a pale-faced rider in a purple hooded cloak with orange trim over a dark steel cap and dark armour, a round dark shield with an orange rim and a white skull on his RIGHT arm on the screen-left side and a long spear with a steel leaf blade in his LEFT hand on the screen-right side, riding a pale grey horse with a dark mane and tail, its tack hung with bone and skull trinkets
hands: the spear stays in the rider's left hand on the screen-right side and the round skull shield on his right arm on the screen-left side
